question: Identify the type of specialised cells found in flatworms that help in osmoregulation.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Flame cells.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Flame cells** are specialized cells that form** part of the excretory system** in these organisms, known as **protonephridia.**
 
• Flame cells play a primary** role in osmoregulation,** the process by which a balance of water and ions is maintained within the body.
 
• Along with osmoregulation, flame cells also help in the **removal of waste products**.
 
• This system is not only found in Platyhelminthes but **also in other types of flatworms and invertebrates**. However, it is most prominent in **Platyhelminthes**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mesoderm**

 
 
• **​**Mesoderm** is a germ layer in an embryo that gives rise to many tissues and structures in the body.**
 
• It's **located between the ectoderm and endoderm, the other two germ layers. **
 
• types of mesoderm
 
• **Paraxial mesoderm**: Forms the vertebrae, dermis, and muscles of the head 
 
• **Intermediate mesoderm: **Forms the urogenital system, including the kidneys and gonads 
 
• **Lateral plate mesoderm**: Forms the splanchnic mesoderm, somatic mesoderm, and extraembryonic membranes 
 
 
 
• **Stem cells**
 
 
• **​**Stem cells **are cells that can develop into many different types of cells in the body.**
 
• They are the foundation cells for all organs and tissues, and they help repair and regenerate damaged cells.
